notes.title: [Sequel] Eternal Senia –Hydrangea After The Rain-
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9100674/b2f1c01e693449779b8838b9f57c783cd55675c6.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone, 
I am the developer of Eternal Senia, "Holy Priest." (Now renamed as "Sanctum.")

I'd like to thank everyone for supporting Eternal Senia
It is with great pleasure that I announce the sequel "Eternal Senia :Hydrangea After The Rain" is just around the corner. 
This time, the game will include English, Japanese and Korean versions.

The core concept of "gaming should not be anything complicated or difficult"
remains in developing a mobile version of the game. 
Eternal Senia on mobile devices will be just as relaxing and a pleasure experience, if not more.
Simply tap on the screen to perform dazzling chained attacks, and make good use of the four skills you have to defeat your opponents.

The story continues with END3 “Eternal Determination”,
Senia with a stronger conviction embark on an adventure,
And we made music and PV with the theme of “Eternal Determination”.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6h9MXu8PBk
This is the one I left the game industry,
And spent three year developing this game.
I hope you will like it. :)

Expected Release date:
[h1][b][url=https://www.eternalsenia2.com/] Learn more ► [/url][/b][/h1]
